C1105.title: Shanghai Police Dismantle Short-Video E-Commerce Fraud Ring, 62 Arrested
C1105.summary: In December 2025, Shanghai Pudong police dismantled a fraud ring operating under the guise of short-video e-commerce part-time jobs, arresting 62 suspects and involving over 5 million yuan. The group lured mainly stay-at-home mothers via social media with promises of daily earnings of thousands from home, using fabricated high-commission screenshots and fake success stories to induce membership fees and later upgrade charges.

references.title: Short-video e-commerce trap targets stay-at-home mothers: over 400 victims and 62 arrests
